title: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to…
description: CVE-2026-115905 is a vulnerability in Microsoft software version 3.0 involving zip file parsing. It relates to a critical parser differential and security control bypass caused by dual-header inconsistencies, a technique referred to as Zip Cloaking. The vulnerability is categorized under CWE-20, indicating improper input validation. No CVSS score or detailed impact metrics are provided. No patch or remediation details are available at this time.
